newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Shares in Fortis Amev rise on strong Q1.
newsitem.headline: Shares in Fortis Amev rise on strong Q1.

text.p: Shares in Fortis Amev rose to a new high of 84.50 guilders after the bank-insurer reported strong first quarter 1997 results.
The stock handed back some of the gains and lingered at 83.10 guilders, 1.60 guilders up on yesterday's close, at 0900 GMT.

Fortis reported an increase in Q1 profits to 204 million ECUs from 157 million. The Dutch parent company Fortis Amev said its net ernings rose to 224 million guilders from 171 million and the Belgian parent company Fortis AG reported net profit of 3.97 bilion francs from 2.73 billion.
